name: Seru Tribunal of Order
description: The Tribunal of Order is the supreme authority of Sanctus Seru. Here, doctrine is declared, purity is defined, and imperial decrees are forged through arcane resonance. Ceremonial decree chambers, purity‑sanctified halls, Praetorian ceremonial guards, and resonance‑bound doctrine pylons ensure absolute obedience to Seru’s vision of Order. All rulings from the Tribunal are final, binding, and enforced across Luclin.
